description: camtensor test media. Downloaded clips are verified by size + SHA-256; generated clips are produced by the ffmpeg arguments below and verified with ffprobe against 'video'. Generated by scripts/fetch-test-media.{ps1,sh} into testdata/media/ (git-ignored).

conventions.ffmpeg: Arguments passed to ffmpeg after '-hide_banner -nostdin -y'; the output path is appended. '{media:NAME}' is replaced by the absolute path of another entry, which must come earlier in this list.
conventions.quick: Entries with quick=true form the --quick / -Quick core set.
conventions.video.gop_s: Fixed keyframe interval (scene-cut detection disabled, closed GOP, IDR).
conventions.video.bitrate_mode: vbr = average bitrate with maxrate/bufsize cap (or capped CRF for gating), cbr = strict CBR (x264 nal-hrd=cbr filler data, x265 strict-cbr), quality = MJPEG fixed quantiser.
conventions.activity: Gating clips only: intervals [start, end] (seconds, inclusive) during which an object moves over an otherwise static scene; start_frame/end_frame are the corresponding frame indices.
conventions.raw_streams: Raw Annex B files (.h264/.hevc) have no container timing: ffprobe guesses their frame rate (often 2x for H.264), so the scripts do not check fps or duration for them, only the frame and keyframe counts.
conventions.rtsp_copy: MJPEG encoded with standard Huffman tables and both quantisation tables (-huffman default -force_duplicated_matrix 1), so it can be published to RTSP (RFC 2435) with -c copy.
